```{r}
setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
actual_data <- read.csv("../../datasets/10_dropped_variables_and_renamed.csv")
```

```{r}
coin_expanding_window_predict <- actual_data %>%
  group_by(coin) %>%
  mutate(week = dmy(week)) %>%
  arrange(week) %>% 
  filter(week > as.Date("2018-01-01")) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Calculate expanding mean (average of all data up to t-1)
    # We use lag() because at week T, you can only know the mean of weeks 1 to T-1
    expanding_mean_y_1 =  slider::slide_dbl(ret_1w_ago, mean, .before = 260, .after = 0)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(expanding_mean_y = slider::slide_dbl(ret_1w_ago, mean, .before = 260, .after = 0)) %>%
  # specific OOS test period
  filter(week <= as.Date("2026-01-08"))

# View result
bch <- coin_expanding_window_predict %>%
  filter(coin == "BCH")

```

```{r}
#calculate_r_square <- function(pred, actual, mean){
#  1 - ((sum((actual - pred)^2)) / (sum((actual - mean)^2)))
#}

calculate_r_square <- function(pred, actual, mean){
  1 - ((sum((actual - pred)^2)) / (sum((actual)^2)))
}

calculate_rmse <- function(pred, actual){
  sqrt(sum((actual-pred)^2))
}
```


## Arima
```{r}
arima_data <- read.csv("../../results/residuals/arima_residuals.csv")

unique_coins <- arima_data$coin %>%
  unique()


all_r_squared <- list()

for (i in unique_coins){
  
  coin_data <- arima_data %>%
    filter(coin == i) %>%
    mutate(week = ymd(week))
  
  rolling_data <- coin_expanding_window_predict %>%
    filter(coin == i) %>%
    select(week, expanding_mean_y_1)
  
  merged <- coin_data %>%
    left_join(rolling_data, by = c("week" = "week"))
  
  r_squared_temp <- calculate_r_square(
    merged$prediction,
    merged$actual, 
    merged$expanding_mean_y_1
  )
  
  
  all_r_squared[["arima"]][[i]] <- r_squared_temp
}

merged_all <- arima_data %>%
  mutate(week = ymd(week)) %>%
  left_join(coin_expanding_window_predict, by = c("coin", "week"))

r_squared_temp <- calculate_r_square(
    merged_all$prediction,
    merged_all$actual, 
    merged_all$expanding_mean_y)

all_r_squared[['arima']][['all']] <- r_squared_temp 
```

## PLS

```{r}
pls_data <- read.csv("../../results/residuals/pls_residuals.csv") %>%

  unique()

}

all_r_squared[['pls']][['all']] <- r_squared_temp 
```

```{r}
df <- data.frame(
  asset = names(all_r_squared$random_forest),
  random_forest = unlist(all_r_squared$random_forest),
  ols = unlist(all_r_squared$ols),
  arima = unlist(all_r_squared$arima),
  panel_fe = unlist(all_r_squared$panel_fe), 
  pls = unlist(all_r_squared$pls)
)

df[,-1] <- lapply(df[,-1], signif, digits = 3)

df <- df[order(df$asset), ]

write.csv(df, "all_models_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
